publisher: Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT)
supersession_scope: Supplemental documentation observations only; does not replace the immutable assessment, admit a connector, or change any readiness wave.

policy.ownership: SDAT publishes the official services and website usage statements and designates SpecPrint as its Corporate File contractor.
policy.allowed_use: This artifact records public documentation facts only and grants no source-data use rights.
policy.terms: SDAT states that data mining software access will be blocked and directs data access to SpecPrint. Do not automate interactive search or data mining; public document retrieval does not authorize source-file automation.
policy.retention: Retain this versioned evidence and citations; no PDF or source records are retained by this prerequisite.
policy.attribution: Attribute official policy to SDAT and contractor pricing/layout documentation to SpecPrint, with the observation date and URL.
policy.redistribution: No retention, transformation, geocoding, commercial derived-use or redistribution rights for source records have been established.

retrieval_evidence_origin: Coordinating-agent documentation retrieval observations supplied to this workstream; byte hashes describe observed responses, not retained source files or a compatibility guarantee.

services.historical_scope: Entities active since 1982; this does not establish current operating status or statewide business completeness.

published_layout.layout_facts_provenance: Previously reviewed positional-layout facts preserved from md-business-source-reassessment-2026-10-03; successful current PDF retrieval does not independently validate delivered source files.

postal.normalization_constraint: Preserve ZIP5 and ZIP4 separately; no postal deliverability or physical-site proof is established.

published_layout.implementation_boundary: Positional declarations, VARCHAR fields and binary-looking numeric positions are documentary constraints only, not a parser contract; preserve source-native identifiers and one-to-many relationships pending current schema verification.

documentation_transport_observation.interpretation: Documentation transport behavior only; browser retrieval success does not grant unattended source-file access, authorize evasion, or override the SDAT search/data-mining restriction.

unresolved_gates: Verify a versioned current schema and compatibility promise against an independently authorized delivered release.
Confirm positional encoding, VARCHAR representation, numeric representation and table inventory.
Confirm ID_BUS_PREFIX plus ID_BUS uniqueness, lifecycle, joins and relationship cardinality.
Obtain status and address-type value dictionaries; establish effective dates and exclude agent/person address roles appropriately.
Confirm full-versus-delta delivery, deletion and correction semantics, replay, completeness counts and checksums.
Review current price, subscription quote, unattended access, agreement, retention, privacy, transformation, commercial derived use and redistribution rights.
Obtain separate explicit acquisition authorization and governed connector approval before any source-file request.
next_action: Maintain HOLD; review current unsigned schema and agreement documentation when separately authorized. Do not automate interactive search or data mining.
